import json, subprocess, sys, time, tempfile, pathlib, random, resource

def make(natoms=8, plen=16, seed=11, nq=64, qlen=120):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    toks = ['t0', 't1']
    atoms = []
    seen = set()
    while len(atoms) < natoms:
        p = tuple(rng.choice(toks) for _ in range(plen))
        if p not in seen:
            seen.add(p); atoms.append(p)
    rules = [{'action': 'allow',
              'when': {'op': 'and', 'args': [{'op': 'contains', 'path': list(p)} for p in atoms]}}]
    q = []
    for i in range(nq):
        q.append([toks[(i + j) % 2] for j in range(qlen)])
    return {'services': toks, 'rules': rules, 'queries': q}

req = make()
line = json.dumps(req).encode()
print('line bytes', len(line))
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as cwd:
    t0 = time.time()
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                       cwd=cwd, input=line + b'\n', capture_output=True)
    dt = time.time() - t0
    ru = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('elapsed %.2fs rc=%d' % (dt, r.returncode), r.stderr.decode()[:200])
obj = json.loads(r.stdout.decode().splitlines()[0])
d = obj['dfa']
print('product-ish minimal states', len(d['next']), 'accepting', sum(d['accept']),
      'out bytes', len(r.stdout), 'max child RSS MB', ru.ru_maxrss / 1024)
print('sample', obj['queries'][:2])
EOF
